title: My Brother Forged My Name And Sold Our Kennel, Sent Me A $12K Check. So I Voided The Sale Now He Wears A Mugshot Vest
description: I drained my $110,000 IRA to back my brother's dog kennel, only to have him forge my name, sell it to a vet chain, and send me a $12,000 check. I found our original agreement in our mother's attic and used ink analysis to void the sale. Now I own Karma Kennels and my brother is court-ordered to clean runs wearing a mugshot vest. #RevengeStory #FamilyBetrayal #KarmaKennels
thumb_text: HE SOLD MY FUTURE FOR $12K. NOW HE WEARS HIS MUGSHOT.
pinned_comment: If your brother drained your $110K IRA, forged your signature on a $680,000 sale, and sent you a $12,000 check, would you have voided the deal or taken a different path? Share your story in the comments.
